title: claw-code：由AI自主开发维护的Rust博物馆展品项目
summary: 该项目名为claw-code，由ultraworkers组织在GitHub上发布，是一个由AI代理（agent）管理的博物馆展品。项目使用Rust语言编写，并基于Gajae-Code和LazyCodex框架或工具链构建。最显著的特点是，该项目的开发和维护过程完全无需人工干预，即由AI系统自主完成代码编写、调试、更新等全流程。这展示了AI在软件工程领域的自主能力，可能涉及自动化编程、自我修复和持续集成等前沿技术。项目本身作为博物馆展品，可能旨在展示AI自主开发的成果，具有教育和展示意义。该项目的技术栈和开发模式对研究AI辅助开发、自主代理系统以及Rust语言在AI领域的应用具有参考价值。
summary_en: The project claw-code, published by ultraworkers on GitHub, is an agent-managed museum exhibit built in Rust with Gajae-Code / LazyCodex. Its key feature is that development and maintenance are carried out with no human intervention, demonstrating AI's autonomous capabilities in software engineering. This project serves as a showcase of AI-driven development, potentially involving automated coding, self-repair, and continuous integration. It offers insights into AI-assisted development, autonomous agent systems, and Rust's application in AI contexts.
